THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the Land to be Acquired : Lot Number 01 - 68 (Lots 68) allotments of land in Preliminary Plan No. Ka.3522 and dated 15.03.2018, situated in the village of Batangala in the Minor Division of Atulugama Korale (West) in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 123-Batangala in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dehiowita in Kegalla District in the Sabaragamuwa Province. 01.
